en: A colorized vintage postcard showing a panoramic view over a wide strait with green hills on the opposite shore and traditional houses with red-tiled roofs in the foreground. A sailing ship is visible on the water. The caption at the top, in French, identifies the scene as a view of Bebek on the Bosphorus in Constantinople. A small logo with the initials 'MB' appears in the lower right corner, and a website watermark 'www.elia.org.gr' is printed across the lower part of the image.
